results.title: 45 Pure Nightmare Seatmate Stories From People Who Completely Lost The Airline Seating Lottery
results.description: Sometimes the destination isn't the difficult part of traveling. The real challenge is surviving the journey there. A few unfortunate passengers discovered this after being seated beside strangers who apparently had no interest in conventional airplane etiquette. What followed included cramped quarters, awkward interactions, and behavior that made several travelers wonder how many hours remained until landing.
